propositions: Native structured output works for specific measured Bedrock cells (sonnet-4-6 with adaptive thinking and haiku-4-5-20251001 with budget thinking) but is blanket-disabled by family-level override; enable these exact cells via per-model-id capability overrides while keeping fail-closed default for all others.

The native_output_with_thinking field must be plumbed through all three ModelCapabilities construction sites (_capabilities_from_profile, string-fallback path, and _intersect_capabilities) to avoid silent override drops; currently all three omit the field and it defaults to False regardless of override setting.

FallbackModel chains must conservatively intersect native_output_with_thinking across all candidates using all(...) logic, so a chain supports native-under-thinking only when every cell is measured to support it.

Bedrock opus-4-7 and opus-4-8 lack server-side support for structured output under thinking and must remain fail-closed to PromptedOutput; their only existing rows (supports_temperature: False) are unrelated and no native-output rows should be added.

Each measured cell row must cite its measurement evidence (E1 account 896586841071, us-east-1 region, experiment df3a) and note that client-side Pydantic validators remain mandatory despite native output using Bedrock schema transform that strips bounds.

Unit tests must pin that native_output_with_thinking overrides reach constructed ModelCapabilities records and are not inert; a mutation dropping the field from any of the three constructor sites must fail the regression test.
